rubrics.justification: Core grading is broadly consistent with the provided 2AB data, but it introduces image-specific details not reliably supported here (uneven cytoplasmic distribution, granularity, asymmetric zona thinning) and labels TE as B despite the lab description being closer to a loose/few-cells pattern.
It integrates age, BMI, FSH, prior IVF outcomes, male factor, endometrium, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis reasonably well, though some links are somewhat speculative.

The reasoning is structured and the probability estimate generally follows from embryo quality plus prior failures, but some deductions (emerging RIF, lifestyle effects, sperm DNA fragmentation impact in this specific case) are stronger than the data supports.

Much of the discussion is broadly evidence-based, but several recommendations are not strongly guideline-supported for routine use in this scenario (ERA/EMMA/ALICE, G-CSF, LMWH, immune/NK testing, low-dose aspirin), and the strong PGT-A recommendation at age 31 is more aggressive than standard guidance.

Provides clear next-step suggestions for transfer support and future workup, including hysteroscopy and sperm DNA fragmentation testing, but some proposed interventions are of uncertain clinical utility and need more nuance.
